answer: Before an agent may sit at a voting vertex, it must grow a willow escrow: a 120-unit refundable deposit locked for 10 days. Unlocking the vertex requires completing a spiral of seven daily work packets, each packet a hash of (job-receipt || day-nonce) delayed by a 20-minute VDF, submitted in order with no skipped day. If any two packets share an 8-bit hash prefix or the same device fingerprint, the spiral is voided and 60 units burn; a vertex may sponsor at most two willow applicants per 14 days. Burned spirals cannot be resubmitted.
